title: King Room | La Quinta Nashville Airport | Shuttle
description:
Located just 2 miles from Nashville International Airport, La Quinta Nashville Airport offers easy access to downtown attractions, including the Grand Ole Opry and Bridgestone Arena. This king room provides a comfortable bed, HDTV, and mini-fridge for a relaxing stay. Guests enjoy modern comfort close to the city’s music and dining scene.

The space
This listing is for a room within a hotel.

✦ Your room  equipped with complimentary toiletries, high definition 55-inch TV, available with Premium cable.

✦ Cleaning services included in the nightly price.

There are a few additional details to know before you book:

✦ The minimum age required for check-in is 21 years old.

✦ Please ensure you have a valid ID for check-in, as it is mandatory for entry.

Guest access
During your stay, you will have access to the property and amenities according to the following schedule:

✦ Check-in is available from 3:00PM to 12:00AM.

✦ You may keep your luggage at the front desk if you arrive early.

✦ Fitness center is available.

✦ Outdoor shared pool available from May 28 to August 31.
Additional features:
    • Lap pool

✦ Free parking lot.

✦ Shuttle service is available upon reservation between 5:00AM and 11:00PM.

Other things to note
There are several additional things to note:

✦ A valid credit or debit card is required for the refundable security deposit and any offline fees displayed upon completing your Airbnb reservation.

✦ Pets are welcome with an additional charge of $25.00 (per night). Dogs and Cats only | 2 Pets Max | 75 lbs max

✦ We use multi-unit listings, so rooms are similar but may have small differences.

✦ The maximum number of days that you may book per reservation is only 28 days.

✦ Free roundtrip airport shuttle at scheduled times.
✦ Breakfast available daily 6AM to 9AM.
✦ Extended parking available onsite for a fee
✦ Pool is seasonal.
✦ Early check-n & late check-out are subject to availability
